hooks.command:
echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"DECIBEL SESSION INIT: Run these tools now before doing anything else:
1. oracle next_actions (project_id: decibel-tools-mcp) — see what is priority
2. voice_inbox_sync (project_id: decibel-tools-mcp) — pull queued voice notes
3. agentic queue_sync (project_id: decibel-tools-mcp) — replay remote agent writes
Do NOT skip these. They ensure you have full context."}}'

hooks.prompt: A git commit is about to be made. Use mcp__decibel-tools__sentinel with action listIssues (project_id: decibel-tools-mcp, status: open) to check for open issues. Review the commit arguments in $ARGUMENTS. If any open issues appear to be addressed by this commit, output JSON with a systemMessage reminding the developer to close them after committing (include the issue IDs). If no issues match, output {}.

Code is about to be pushed. Run mcp__decibel-tools__guardian with action report (project_id: decibel-tools-mcp) to scan for security issues. If ANY findings are grade D or F, output JSON: {"continue": false, "stopReason": "Guardian found critical issues (grade D/F). Fix these before pushing: [list findings]"}. If all findings are grade C or better, output {}.

A file was just edited. Check the tool_input in $ARGUMENTS for the file_path. If the file path matches ANY of these architecture-sensitive paths: src/kernel.ts, src/transports/, src/server.ts, src/httpServer.ts, src/facades/definitions.ts, src/facades/index.ts, src/license.ts, src/daemonConfig.ts — output: {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"ARCHITECTURE NUDGE: You just modified an architecture-sensitive file. If this is a non-trivial architectural change, consider recording an ADR via architect createAdr. Check existing ADRs first with architect list_adrs."}}. If the path does NOT match any of those, output exactly: {}
